Something went wrong while handling an incoming email, so the applicant may not have received a reply and the candidate row or resume file may not have been saved.

  • Reference: @{coalesce(outputs('AppRef'),'n/a')}
  • From: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['from'],'unknown')}
  • Subject: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['subject'],'(none)')}
  • Received: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['receivedDateTime'],'(unknown)')}

Open the flow run history for the exact step and error. The failed email is moved unread to Archive so it cannot block the Inbox queue.
